title: Current UMass Amherst Dining tools ecosystem
scope: UMass Amherst, not other UMass campuses
inclusion_policy: Only tools or services with recent affirmative evidence of operational use. Pilot-only or unconfirmed current deployments are omitted. Historical instruments may be named only in the separate ten-year waste report.

tools.name: Metafoodx

deployment_history.event: Vendor summary reports coverage at all four dining commons and Harvest Market

tools.assumption_for_the_build: Primary prospective source of item-level production and leftover observations. Use clearly labeled mock files until UMass authorizes exports; do not describe a live connection.
limitations: Serving-line depletion is not directly measured human ingestion.
A reported produced-minus-leftover balance may estimate food served; it does not measure plate waste.
Portions require documented serving weights; weights should remain the primary unit.
Any device API, export format or real-time feed remains unverified.
Coverage is not necessarily identical across every station or service period.
No campus-wide causal percentage can be assigned solely to this tool.

tools.name: FoodPro / production planning
tools.ecosystem_role: Menu, recipe, inventory and production planning

evidence.detail: Vendor describes integration with UMass food management software Foodpro
UMass Catering job description names FoodPro menu management and inventory implementation

tools.assumption_for_the_build: Export a generic production sheet that a manager can review and enter into the planning system. Naming FoodPro as a documented ecosystem component is supported; automated writeback is not.
limitations: Public menu endpoints alone do not establish internal production-system capabilities.
No current configuration across every dining location was obtained.
No verified integration between this prototype and FoodPro.
No FoodPro-only waste-reduction percentage was found.

tools.name: UCard meal transactions / CBORD GET
tools.ecosystem_role: Meal-plan balance and usage records; candidate demand signal

current_use_evidence.evidence: UMass FAQ links meal-plan balances and usage to get.cbord.com/umass.

tools.assumption_for_the_build: Use anonymized time-binned admission counts supplied by Dining. Treat timestamp resolution, location coverage and all-entry coverage as requirements to verify.
limitations: GET access for students does not prove a public bulk API or administrator export.
Meal transactions are not dish choices.
Repeat entries are not unique students; admissions are not simultaneous occupancy.
Cash, credit, guests and retail transactions may be represented differently.
No individual student identifiers are required for the proposed forecasting layer.
No swipe-system-specific waste-reduction effect was found.

tools.name: Food Recovery Network
tools.ecosystem_role: Recovery and redistribution of edible surplus
tools.assumption_for_the_build: Produce a manager-reviewed surplus pickup note. Worcester pickup and unscheduled end-of-night collection are proposed extensions, not confirmed current FRN routes.
limitations: Forecast surplus is not automatically safe or accepted for donation.
Food safety and pickup eligibility require existing Dining/FRN procedures.
Redistribution is not the same as preventing overproduction.
Do not promise a current Worcester pickup service.
Current schedule supersedes older generic FAQ descriptions.

tools.name: Vanguard Renewables / Barstow's Farm anaerobic digestion
tools.ecosystem_role: Downstream processing of collected food scraps

current_use_evidence.coverage: Collected pre- and post-consumer food waste from dining commons, Campus Center and retail locations

tools.assumption_for_the_build: Keep as downstream context, outside the core food-production optimizer. Distinguish landfill diversion from source reduction.
limitations: Diverted food has already entered a waste stream.
More diverted tonnage can reflect better capture or greater activity; it does not by itself establish less food waste.
Tonnage does not identify avoidable edible waste separately from unavoidable scraps.
Generic composting descriptions are historical or may describe other streams; current Dining sources identify anaerobic digestion.

measurement_contract.balance_rule: Opening balance + production + transfers in = estimated served + remaining balance + documented transfers or removals. Avoid counting the same leftover more than once.
measurement_contract.model_output_disclosure: Simulated savings must be labeled simulated and kept separate from published historical effects.
